ops.title: Orphan-recovery signal TOCTOU is POSIX-inherent on darwin
ops.body: The reap ladder's final probe→signal step in reapOrphan/reapIdentity is non-atomic for prior-generation orphans: they are not this process's children, so no wait4 pins their PID, and a reused PID can slot in during the microseconds between the last identity probe and the signal. The wait4-pins-the-pid mitigation applies only to the driver path over direct children (P1b build report §7.8, corrected). The window is POSIX-inherent on darwin — no pidfd for non-children — and cannot be closed without kqueue/pidfd process watching. Maximal mitigation in internal/proc/reap.go: identity is re-verified via matches on every grace poll, a mismatch caught in-loop settles as ReapReused and is never SIGKILLed (TestReapPIDReuseDuringGraceIsNeverKilled), and SIGTERM — polite — is the only signal a wrong PID could plausibly receive in the residual microsecond window.
